The '''Dreadfarm''' is a location in the [[Rift Dimension]]. It is based on the {{zone|Farm}}.

{{RiftGuide|Enigma: Farm Balloons|Enigma: Farm Flower Pot|Enigma: Beanstalk|Reed's Boat: Replacement Wood|Eye: The Baba Yaga|Harvest for Shania|Montezuma's Fifth|souls=4}}
== Features ==
The '''Dreadfarm''' features many attractions. The player must have secured the {{Item|Supreme Timecharm}} in order to access the location.

=== Crops ===
{{Main|Agaricus Cap|Caducous Stem|Wilted Berberis}}
The '''Dreadfarm''' has multiple small plots, where a variety of plants grow. All of the crops must be harvested with a {{Item|Wand of Farming}} to yield items. 

Looking at the {{Item|Brown Mushroom|link=}}s on the ground for a few seconds will make them briefly turn {{Item|Red Mushroom|text=red|link=}}, at which point the player can harvest them to yield an {{Item|Agaricus Cap}}. Additionally, clicking the {{Item|Rose Bush|link=}}es from top to bottom will drop {{Item|Caducous Stem}}s, and breaking any of the {{Item|Dead Bush|link=}}es surrounded with purple particles give {{Item|Wilted Berberis}}.

=== Balloons ===
Floating above a chest at one end of the '''Dreadfarm''' is a large bunch of balloons. The player must shoot each and every one of them with a {{Item|Berberis Blowgun}} to drop the {{ID|Anvil|link=}} keeping them in the air, which will unlock the chest and reveal an [[#Enigma Souls|Enigma Soul]].

=== The Baba Yaga ===
{{See also|Porhtal}}
One of [[Porhtal]]'s eyes, The Baba Yaga, can be found in the '''Dreadfarm'''. The eye's condition is {{DarkRed|'''ROGUE'''}}, and can be defeated to gain a permanent {{stat|rt|+30}} and the ability to instantly teleport to it from [[Porhtal]] or any of their other eyes. Teleporting to The Baba Yaga costs {{stat|rt|7m30s}} and can only be done if the player has enough time remaining.

=== Montezuma Cat Soul ===
{{Main|Montezuma Pet}}
Located behind a [[weak wall]] made of cracked stone bricks, the player can find the fifth [[Montezuma Pet|Montezuma Soul Piece]], which is located at {{Coords|-24|72|-198}}. The wall can be broken down using a {{Item|Horsezooka}}, and finding the soul piece will add an additional {{stat|rt|+15}} to the [[Montezuma Pet|Pet]].
